head_sha.description: git HEAD when the scope ran; "unknown" outside a git repo, or when HEAD moved while the commands ran (its value or its reflog differed between the start and the end of the run). Optional: artifacts written before this field existed carry no SHA and are treated as unpairable.

pr_head_sha.description: the pull-request head commit this run reports about, when the CI event supplies one. Present when head_sha is a merge ref built by the CI checkout.

dirty.description: the working tree carried uncommitted content when the scope ran — measured before the first command and after the last, and true if either says so — so the commands judged more (or less) than head_sha. Absent means not recorded, never clean.

runner.description: the runner repo.yaml declares for this step. Present only on a declared step; the summary line's pytest counts are read from these steps alone.

diagnosis.description: why this step failed, when the reason is that it never ran — the binary it invokes is not on PATH, or the shell answered 127. Present only on such a step. It DIAGNOSES without EXCUSING: the step is still failed and the scope is still red, because a command that never ran proved nothing.
